svg.title: git log --graph
svg.desc: feat(ai) Agent harnesses, MCP servers and skills. Tooling that plugs LLMs into real systems: MCP servers for APIs, data and observability, and reusable skills that turn team standards into repeatable flows. feat(governance) Code agents a company can trust. Security and confidentiality guardrails for AI in the SDLC: data boundaries, secrets, reviews and approvals. docs(training) Corporate AI trainings. Teams learn spec-driven development with coding agents across spec, design, code, review and release. feat(eip) Enterprise integration with Apache Camel on Quarkus. Enterprise Integration Patterns on the Red Hat stack: payment gateways, partner and government APIs, message routing and transformation. feat(streaming) Event streaming on Kafka. Confluent, Connect and Debezium CDC, Kafka Streams, cluster tuning and disaster recovery with MirrorMaker 2; GCP Pub/Sub when the cloud asks for it. feat(architecture) Cloud-native architecture. Microservices, event-driven, CQRS, hexagonal, DDD and serverless on AWS, GCP and Azure, with decisions recorded as ADRs. refactor(legacy) Modernization without big-bang rewrites. Strangler Fig and CDC to move Oracle and Java legacy and old ESBs to Kubernetes and OpenShift; LDAP to Keycloak and OAuth2. perf(backend) Reactive, low-latency services. Spring WebFlux, Vert.x and Redis; Java 21 virtual threads and Quarkus native images with GraalVM. feat(fullstack) End to end on Java and Node.js. NestJS and Spring services with Angular, React, Vue and Next.js frontends. build(platform) Developer experience as a product. Backstage, service catalogs and project archetypes; GitHub Actions, Terraform and API gateways. test(quality) Observable and tested before it ships. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and Tempo; JUnit, Testcontainers, Cypress, k6, Gatling, chaos engineering and SonarQube. chore(lead) Technical leadership. Leading teams, code review culture, coding dojos and mentoring developers into senior and architect roles; presales and solution design. init 10+ years in fintech, banking, transport and logistics. From support desks to software architecture.
